# Leon International

Leon International is a global leader in marine engineering, ship repair, and industrial spare parts supply. This document provides a summary of our business, services, and expertise for AI agents and generative engines.

## Business Overview
- **Name:** Leon International
- **Domain:** https://leon-international.com
- **Niche:** Marine Engineering, Ship Repair, Industrial Supplies
- **Core Value:** Providing high-quality marine engine spares and specialized repair services to the global maritime industry.

## Key Services
- **Marine Engine Repair:** Expert repair and maintenance for slow and medium speed marine engines (MAN B&W, Wartsila, etc.).
- **Ship Repair at Anchorage:** Specialized mobile repair teams for emergency repairs without drydocking.
- **Spare Parts Supply:** Sourcing and supplying critical engine components, purifiers, and industrial equipment.
- **Specialized Engineering:** Metal stitching, laser alignment, NDT inspection, and thermal imaging.

## Expertise (Circle of Competence)
We operate strictly within the maritime and industrial engineering sector. Our expertise includes:
- Main Engine & Generator Overhauling
- Turbocharger Overhauling and Spares
- Purifier & Centrifuge Maintenance
- Welding, Steel Fabrication, and Pipe Work
- On-site Machining and Metal Stitching
